name: campus-connect
description: Campus Connect — college-verified student social and networking app

scripts.build:hosting: npm run build:admin && npm run build:student && npm run prepare:hosting
scripts.build: npm run build:functions && npm run build:hosting
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage 'npm run test:rules --workspace campus-connect-functions'
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:functions && npm run test:student
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace campus-connect-functions && npm run typecheck --workspace campus-connect-student

author: Campus Connect Team
